title: He Walked Into A Trap Meant For His Friend . . . And It Went Horribly Wrong (Episode 6)
caption:
Weak Hero Class 1, episode 6: Bobby hires a fighter named Wolf to beat Max on his birthday.
When the plan goes wrong, Sam walks into the trap instead. Follow for episode 7!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom
comment: Would you forgive Bobby after what he did to Max and Sam? Why?

segments.say: Bobby lures Sam into a dark basement, and a gang is waiting to stomp him *flat*.
To see how it got here, go back to the morning Bobby showed up *hungover*.
He sat through math class with a pounding head, while his new friends could not stop *laughing*.
Tom and Ben kept bragging about last night. Funny, because Bobby had *paid* for all of it.
Those two were not friends. They were *customers*.
Sam saw it, so he walked up and asked why Bobby kept ignoring his *calls*.
Bobby just snapped back. It's none of your *business*.
Max looked down on me from the start, Bobby said. I was only a *lackey*.
So he turned his back on both of them and went to *party*.
At a club, Bobby introduced himself as an assemblyman's son, and the whole table *cheered*.
They also introduced Wolf, a cocky *fighter* who films himself beating up posers.
Bobby trashed Max in front of them. He thinks he's king. I'll *beat* him one day.
Meanwhile Max was working nights as a delivery rider, and Sam rode out to see *him*.
Later they sat outside a shop, and Sam said Tom and Ben were just using Bobby for *money*.
Next day, Sam told Tom and Ben to stop. They shrugged. If Bobby wants to pay, what's the *problem*?
Sam only said that Bobby might be *lonely*.
Then Bobby cut into the lunch line. Someone told him to get back, and the whole cafeteria *watched*.
Bobby was humiliated in front of everyone, and now he wanted *revenge*.
He asked his gang if anyone knew someone who could take Max out. I can *pay*.
Then Wolf's channel popped up on a phone. He throws good punches, and a million won buys *him*.
The fight was set for Saturday, Max's birthday, and Wolf would *livestream* it.
But Tom and Ben did not want to wait, so they went after Max's *scooter*.
They cut into it. Could this really kill him? Don't know. Don't *care*.
That night Max came flying down the road, and his scooter went *down*.
He lay in the middle of the street while Bobby and the others *ran*.
That was the moment Bobby crossed the *line*.
Next morning Max came to school hurting. Sam asked what happened. It's no big *deal*.
Bobby stared at Sam, then snapped. Don't look at me. You make me *sick*.
Max's birthday finally came, and Sam and Amy filled the apartment with balloons and *pizza*.
Wolf kept calling Bobby from his boxing gym, but the number could not be *reached*.
At home Sam cooked seaweed soup, because it tastes better the longer it *cooks*.
Then Amy's phone lit up. Bobby wanted to give her Max's present, and she had to come out *alone*.
She slipped out and met him at a cafe, where Bobby said he'd make everyone make *up*.
But Amy did not look *sure*.
Back at home they played games and waited, but her phone went *dead*.
Then a picture of Amy popped up on a phone, with an *address*.
He told everyone he was going to the shop, and walked out *alone*.
In an empty parking garage Bobby grilled Amy. Are you dating *Max*?
Then a boy walked in, and it was not *Max*.
Amy shoved Sam toward the stairs. You go first. I'll get the *police*.
Sam grabbed a pipe, and for a minute he actually *won*.
Then Wolf strolled in, and he was not *impressed*.

segments.text: I said let him go. I only need Su-ho.

segments.say: It did not matter. The gang kept stomping Sam anyway, and Bobby just *watched*.
Wolf wanted a new date for the fight and his money for *today*.
Then someone yelled that the cops were called, and the gang *scattered*.

segments.text: You thought you won, didn't you?

segments.say: One boy stayed behind to smile over Sam, and that smile felt *wrong*.
Sam lies alone in the dark, and Max is still at home waiting for *him*.
Will Max find out in *time*?
